commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: End the great hunger of the poor, for the sake of righteousness. That righteousness is where someone who has wealth stores it for their own later use. Hunger is called ruinous because it destroys all that is good. The wealth spent on ending it comes back to help you.
